_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and replace every value with your own ids. Field reference: docs/configuration.md. Straight quotes, numeric ids. Every number below is a made-up placeholder. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

source.name: Kleer
source._rerun_hint_note: Optional. Ends the 'week not approved' error: 'Approve the week in Kleer, then <rerun_hint>.' Put your own way of re-running here, e.g. "ask your agent to run the time-assistant skill again".

targets.name: client
targets._note: One entry per system that should receive copies. Setup for this type: docs/targets/timekeeper.md. Run `python3 sync.py discover` for the ids.

settings._project_name: Consulting engagement (the INTERNAL id from `discover`, not the project number)

default._note: Wage codes are listed by `python3 sync.py discover`.

allowance_map._note: Optional: replicate traktamente (daily allowances). Leave this out and allowances are listed but not written. In TimeKeeper these are the 'Övrigt' wage codes for inrikes and utrikes traktamente.
